title: spec(ui): FormViewSchema declares drawerSide / drawerWidth and buttons.reset, but no console entry point renders a drawer form or a reset button; implement or retire them (ADR-0049)
body:
Filing gate **② follow-up work owed by landed work**: this is the remainder of #26843 that its triage ruling sends to the spec lane. Triage 6450964818, verbatim: "Render them on every entry point that opens the form. If a key should not exist, its retirement is a spec card, not silence." PR #27027 (`Refs #26843`, merged 2026-10-28 08:27Z) made `buttons`, `layout`, `defaults`, `defaultTab` and `tabPosition` reach every console form entry point. ui seat 2 split the three keys below out of it before dispatch and files them here, as its dispatch order on #26843 says.

## What is declared but never rendered (read at `origin/main` `58668776`)

`FormViewSchema`, `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`:
- ≈L4624 `drawerSide: enum(top|bottom|left|right)`, "Drawer side (drawer forms)".
- ≈L4626 `drawerWidth`, already `[DEPRECATED → size buckets]`.
- ≈L4807 `buttons.reset: FormButtonConfigSchema`, "Reset button".

No console page hands a form view to a drawer renderer: the form opens full page, as the New dialog or as the form page. No form renders a reset button, and `reset.label` is never read. `packages/spec/liveness/view.json` may still mark these `live`; re-read it.

## Expected

Per ADR-0049 (enforce-or-remove), one of:
- **Implement:** a drawer open mode for a form view and a reset button. A drawer is an open mode in the console navigation overlay (epic #26676 territory), so the ui half would be a `domain:ui` card after this one.
- **Retire:** narrow `FormViewSchema` (tombstone `drawerSide` / `drawerWidth` / `buttons.reset` with prescriptions) and flip the liveness rows.

The spec seat picks one and records why. Retiring is a narrowing (`Clause-②`), so it owes the contract review that narrowings owe.

## Business reason

Authors and agents write `drawerSide: 'right'` or a `reset` button, the schema accepts it, and nothing happens. That is the "declared ⇒ enforced" gap #26843 was filed for.

## Reader who acts

The `domain:spec` seat, after triage. The ui seats can implement only if the spec keeps the keys and the drawer open mode is in reach.

## Dedupe

I listed open `domain:spec` issues and checked titles for drawer / reset / form view: 0 hits. **New.**
